Aida, an innovative project by
Darglobal
, seamlessly integrates luxury and nature into a singular and carefully considered experience at the hilltops of Muscat, Oman. At Aida, you will indulge in the awe-inspiring sights of the seascape and the captivating Muscat mountains from the comfort and security of your opulent spa villa. The project includes various villa types designed to suit your preferences. These include oceanfront mansions, golf-front villas, park-front attached villas and a 5-star hotel. The community covers approximately 37,670,000 square feet of land.
Aida’s Perfect Location
Aida is located in the center of Muscat, 130 meters above the shoreline. Muscat is the capital city of Oman, on the southeastern Arabian Peninsula coast along the Gulf of Oman. Muscat is known for its stunning coastal landscapes. The Gulf of Oman provides the city with picturesque beaches. For this reason, nature surrounds Aida from every angle. Moreover, Aida is close to Muscat Oman landmarks such as Nikki Beach Resort and Spa, The Jumeirah Hotels, Yiti Beach and Yenkit Beach. Conveniently, you will find it only 20 minutes from Downtown Muscat and Muscat International Airport.
Aida Oceana
The first stage of the Aida project is named Oceana. Aida’s remarkable complex features 3-bedroom linked villas, 4 & 5-bedroom villas, and 6 & 7-bedroom mansions with a size ranging from 1300 sq. ft to 19,302 sq. ft.
The villas are at the forefront of the Trump International Golf Club – Oman, in Ayla, Muscat. Each villa is meticulously designed to offer a harmonious blend of spacious and sunny interiors, equipped with modern features and complemented by panoramic views of the golf club.
One of the key features of the Aida Muscat villas is the one-of-a-kind spa experience. Step into luxury with an outdoor hot tub and an indoor steam room integrated into the master bedroom. These exceptional villas prioritize your well-being and comfort, offering a specially designed resort to help you unwind and forget all your problems. Even while enjoying the outdoor hot tub, the villa is designed to provide you with the highest level of privacy.
Oceanfront Villa
The first type of villa in Aida is the oceanfront villa. Visualize being in a villa overlooking the ocean and continuously listening to the soothing sound of waves serenading your rooms like a melody. These exclusive properties are designed to maximize the experience of coastal living, with the primary focus on providing residents with breathtaking vistas of the sea. Oceanfront villas typically feature expansive windows and balconies that allow occupants to immerse themselves in the scenic beauty of the ocean, including captivating sunrises or sunsets. The design is made specifically to evoke the ambience of The Maldives, focusing on serenity and tranquility as well as luxury and novelty.
Golf-front Villa
The second type of villas are golf-front villas. A standout feature in Aida is the exceptional ‘Trump International Golf Club – Oman,’ renowned as one of the most luxurious golf clubs. These villas are carefully positioned to offer an immersive experience for golf enthusiasts, allowing them to enjoy the scenic beauty of the golf course from the comfort of their homes. Owners at Aida can obtain a free membership at the golf club and get the chance to enjoy enjoyable strolls or engage in the sport itself.
Park-Front Villa
The third type of villa is the park front villas. These exclusive homes offer plentiful features and a scenic environment, allowing residents to enjoy a tranquil and aesthetically pleasing setting. The villas provide a seamless blend of nature and luxury. They boast high-end amenities, spacious interiors, and carefully designed landscapes, creating an upscale living experience for those who value both comfort and a connection to nature.
Amenities surrounding the Villas
Besides the Trump International Golf Club club membership, Aida residents are surrounded by various amenities and outdoor activities.
Aida’s clubhouse offers a variety of entertainment and well-being amenities, including wellness centers, fitness centers, swimming pools, 5-star dining options, cafes, promenades, and many more.
One of the prominent amenities in Aida is the open-air lounge. The open-air lounge is a stylish, comfortable outdoor space for relaxation and socializing in a laid-back environment. It is situated in the open, providing guests with a pleasant atmosphere and a connection to the surrounding environment with scenic views, fresh air, and a sense of openness.
On top of that, there’s also space for individuals with a passion for outdoor physical activities. Aida is equipped with running, hiking, and mountain biking trails. The well-maintained running trail is situated in scenic environments amongst parks and waterfronts, providing runners with pleasant views and a connection to nature. There are also designated lanes for cyclists, ensuring a safe and organised space for both runners and cyclists. Aida offers a unique mountain biking experience. Mountain biking provides a dynamic and immersive experience, blending physical activity with the joy of exploration in natural landscapes. The sport appeals to those seeking adventure, challenge, and a connection to the great outdoors. As for hiking trails, they lead to scenic viewpoints that overlook natural landmarks, providing hikers with rewarding views as they progress along the hike.
Hotels in Aida go beyond mere accommodation, offering plentiful amenities, impeccable service, and exquisite attention to detail. The luxurious hotels boast impressive and aesthetically pleasing architecture and interior design. Guests can view the ocean fronts and picturesque landscapes and are offered convenient access to attractions.
Aida is also rich in plazas, cafes and restaurants. Restaurants in Aida redefine the dining experience by combining exceptional cuisine with rich surroundings and impeccable service.
Aida by Darglobal
is a distinctive destination that offers an ideal setting to rediscover a connection with nature and to transport its residents to a more pristine realm. The development provides proximity to fresh air, natural sunlight, and green surroundings that can reduce stress, enhance mood, and increase overall well-being.

Below, we will take you on a tour to explore the top most-visited shopping malls in the capital. This list includes Panorama Mall and Granda Mall. So, let’s begin.

Anchored at the intersection of Takhassusi and Tahlia Street, this mall is one of the masterpieces already installed in the capital city. Its broad panoramic view and uniquely -designed architecture, added to its distinctive location, made it a sought-after destination for many tourists, mainly because it includes many of the highly chosen brands that suit all customer segments, including Danube Hypermarket, Jarir Bookstore, Att, Lamborghini Cafe, Zara, Hamleys, Marks & Spencer, Chopard and Rolex.

Inaugurated on 30 April 2018 in the al-Aqeeq district of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, this magnificent mall occupies a space of 132000 square meters. It includes many international brands specialising in fashion, shoes, bags, tech devices, and a movie theatre in the shopping centre.

8. Granada Center
Located in the eastern ring road highway (airport direction) between exits 8-9 Ghernata District in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Granada Center houses 235 shops on a covered area of 150,000 m2. The mall is considered one of the largest shopping centres in Riyadh and contains many brands of clothing, watches and gifts. There is also a kids’ area where children can have joy, in addition to some restaurants and cafes.
9. Al Faisaliah Mall
Faisaliah Tower and Mall was established in 2000. Covering a space of 55 thousand square meters, Al Faisaliah Mall is an architectural masterpiece by all aesthetic standards due to its streamlined oval design. The building is moulded into a pyramidal shape with curved edges roofed with a glass ball that gives a charming view. More than 100 stores are distributed carefully in this mall to bid the most luxurious and famous international brands. 10. Riyadh Front
Roshan Front, formerly Riyadh Front, is a perfect destination for business, entertainment, shopping and hospitality. It is located north of Riyadh on the road leading to King Khalid International Airport. It is divided into a business and shopping front, with two hotels for each and separated by a public park in the middle.
